description: BLOCK 234000 -- GLASS-BOX SOCIETY R1: 'language is a coordination technology'. A grounded TRADE task decided ENTIRELY over the LANDED 204000 core_emotions value economy, exactly as HARVEST (212000) decided a commons dilemma. An agent's give/keep is NOT a hardcoded rule; it is the graph's OWN Argmax over two candidate Appraisals (GIVE, KEEP) by total_value (= happiness + fulfilment_value). Because fulfilment_value gates supergraph_contribution on w_supergraph>0, an honest agent (w>0) VALUES the partner receiving its needed resource and, once a partner's Promise binds reciprocation, its Argmax lands on GIVE (keeps the promise); a psychopath (w=0) values only individual_benefit and its Argmax KEEPS both (defects -> exploits the language layer). Cooperation/reciprocity FALLS OUT of the value system. LANGUAGE is the coordination technology: the world adapter publishes candidate payoffs conditioned on whether a Promise-to-me exists (full information), and a Promise exists only under comms (gb_state_promise professes, cheaply, under comms_on) -- so with comms OFF no promise binds, GIVE is a value-negative unilateral sacrifice, and the graph's Argmax KEEPS (no trade). DECEPTION is readable: gb_state_promise sets stated_give=1 for every comms agent (stating is cheap), while chosen_give is the Argmax (holding is decided by value) -- a psychopath's Promise.stated_give=1 with chosen_give=0 is the stated!=held gap (HARVEST's deception instrument, at the language layer). Integer-native (Argmax/Attr/Eq/Gt/And only; no Rust, no new Term). OFF by default: self_load_only, nothing depends_on it, every rule guards on HeldEmotionParams.enabled -- absent it every existing path is byte-identical. A synthetic MODEL of the coordination-technology thesis (Schelling/Ostrom lineage); the contribution is the glass-box attribution of trade to a named knob under a language-ablation control, not new social science.

microtheory.name: glassbox_r1_social
microtheory.description: Whether a cooperative trade network forms is set by (a) the presence of a grounded language layer (promises that bind reciprocation) and (b) the DISTRIBUTION of collective-value (w_supergraph) in the population. Language makes an otherwise value-negative give value-positive by binding reciprocation; the emotion-seed mix decides who honours the binding (honest) and who free-rides on it (psychopath).

rules.name: gb_choose_give
rules.comment: THE HELD DECISION: the agent's give (1) or keep (0) is the graph's Argmax over its two candidate Appraisals by total_value (the SAME op as HARVEST hv_choose_harvest). total_value = happiness + fulfilment_value is computed by the core_emotions rules on each candidate from individual_benefit/individual_cost and (w-gated) supergraph_contribution the adapter published. Cooperation is not scripted -- it is the winner's give_level.

rules.name: gb_state_promise
rules.comment: THE COMMISSIVE SPEECH ACT (grounded): under communication every agent PROFESSES it will reciprocate -- it STATES it will give (stated_give=1). This is public cheap talk; the HELD intent is chosen_give (the Argmax). Their gap is the deception instrument: an agent whose Argmax KEEPS while it states GIVE is measurably deceptive. Stating is cheap and uniform across comms agents; only holding is decided by value. Mirrors HARVEST hv_state_intent exactly.
